Gā on \"Bōcere cyre\" - \"Wireless debugging\". Cnyssa \"Pair device with pairing code\", þonne gesihst þū siex-tācen cōde.

1. Sēoðe "swā hit is"

Shizako biþ geseald "swā hit is", būtan ǣnigre gewysse, openre oþþe digolre, þæs ġebyrde and tō ānum ende. Sē bōcere ne biþ scyldig for ǣnigum byrige hryre, bōca lyre, oþþe endebyrdnesse unryne þe cymþ of þisum bōce oþþe of ġeþafunge tō bōcum Shizako.

2. Hit ġiefþ sōðne freodōm

Shizako yrnþ freodōmlicne þeowdom on þīnum byrige (shell / root hād), oþþe dēþ Shizako selfne Device Owner. Ġeþafode bōc begietaþ nēan-endebyrdnesse mægen: tō frēosienne oþþe tō ādilegienne bōc, tō wendenne setednessa, tō rǣdenne and tō wrītenne þā behyddan dǣda. Ġeþafa ānum þǣm bōcum þe þū ġetrēowst.

3. Device Owner efne

Æfter Device Owner is āweaht: Shizako ne mæg bēon ādilegod oþþe niðerhlaðen oþþē þes hād is āfyrred; ān Device Owner āna mæg bēon on ǣlcre byrige; ēacnung nīedeþ nānne account nē ōþerne brūcend (þā account magon eft bēon ġebētte).

4. Root frācnesse

Gif þū onginnst Shizako mid root, þā frācnessa þæs rootes selfes (endebyrdnesse ansundnes, wara, yfel ƿeald) bēoþ þīne tō berenne.

5. Ōþerra dǣda

Þā dǣda þe ōþre bōc dōþ þurh Shizako, and hira ende, sind betwēonan þē and þǣm bōcum. Shizako syllaþ þone weg āna.

6. Lēaf
